provenance: Pretrained on COCO train2017 by Ultralytics — no local training run

dataset.source: coco128 (Ultralytics) — a 128-image subset of real COCO train2017
dataset.download: Auto-downloaded via ultralytics on first use — no manual download
dataset.note: Metrics below are computed by ultralytics' own validator (model.val()) against coco128's real ground-truth labels — genuine mAP/precision/recall, not a proxy. coco128 is a 128-image sanity-check subset (not the full 5,000-image COCO val2017), so its mAP will differ from the officially published val2017 benchmark reported alongside it below.
